_comment: WS1 Session M — the onnxruntime C runtime the bundled FA path loads. This file is the COMMITTED source of truth for which runtime the app ships; the binaries themselves are gitignored (platform-specific) and re-provisioned from README.md. The guard test scripts/onnxruntimeBundle.guard.test.ts asserts (a) apiVersion here == the ORT_API_VERSION the pinned `ort` in Cargo.toml computes for every target entry, and (b) minorVersion >= apiVersion, so a future `ort` bump that raises the required C-API version fails loudly here instead of silently at runtime. WS2 Step 13 Phase 4 widened this from a single macOS-x86_64 object to a `targets` array — one entry per (os, arch) fa_onnx.rs::SUPPORTED_ORT_TARGETS accepts — when Windows x86_64 and macOS aarch64 provisioning were added.
apiVersionRationale: With no `api-NN` feature enabled, ort-sys rc.13's version.rs computes ORT_API_VERSION = 17 (the floor). onnxruntime's C API is backward-compatible, so any runtime whose minor version is >= 17 satisfies it; 1.23.2 is the version pinned for every target below.

targets.note: Upstream per-arch dylib as published by Microsoft. Bundled by build.yml AFTER lipo'ing with the aarch64 dylib below into one universal file at this same filename/sha256-of-the-fat-binary — see the 'universal' entry for the actually-shipped artifact's own hash.
Upstream per-arch dylib as published by Microsoft (MEASURED 2026-08-27). Bundled by build.yml AFTER lipo'ing with the x86_64 dylib above into one universal file — see the 'universal' entry.

The ACTUALLY-SHIPPED artifact for the universal-apple-darwin bundle target: `lipo -create` of the x86_64 and aarch64 entries above. MEASURED 2026-08-27 by performing this lipo locally: `lipo -info` reports both 'x86_64 arm64' slices present, and the file `dlopen()`s successfully on this session's real Intel (x86_64) hardware via Python's ctypes.CDLL — the arm64 slice's own load/runtime behavior is UNVERIFIED (no Apple Silicon hardware available this session). Not a separate arch fa_onnx.rs's target table resolves against directly (macos-x86_64 and macos-aarch64 both resolve to this same filename) — recorded here so the exact shipped bytes have a committed hash independent of the two per-arch source hashes above.

MEASURED 2026-08-27 from Microsoft's onnxruntime-win-x64-1.23.2.zip release asset. Requires onnxruntime_providers_shared.dll (below) co-located in the same onnxruntime/ resource folder — onnxruntime.dll loads it implicitly via the Windows DLL search order, never referenced by path in code. UNVERIFIED at runtime — no Windows hardware available this session; also requires the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64) to be present on the target machine (OPERATOR-ATTESTED from onnxruntime's published system requirements, not independently confirmed) — see build.yml's own comment on this and docs/ws2-fa-models/ort-provisioning.md.

MEASURED 2026-08-27, same release asset as onnxruntime.dll above. A dependency of onnxruntime.dll, not a second engine — has no independent apiVersion/minorVersion of its own (omitted rather than duplicated) and is not itself named by fa_onnx.rs's target table; only bundled alongside.
